paper: Das (2014) arXiv:1406.5271 — Spin-orbit density wave (SODW), URu2Si2 hidden order

open_questions.question: Does using the realistic WIEN2k DFT Fermi surface (rather than a single nested tight-binding pocket) recover the ~40% FS spectral-weight loss and ~24% R ln2 entropy release?
open_questions.why_it_matters: These integrated quantities are the extensive thermodynamic fingerprints of the HO transition and are the main under-reproduced numbers in this model replication (we get ~6% and ~0.006 k_B ln2). They test whether the gap phenomenology is quantitatively, not just qualitatively, an SODW.
open_questions.next_step: Downfold DFT bands for URu2Si2 near E_F onto the two spin-orbit-split 5f orbitals, identify the (110)/(100) hot-spot nesting at Q=0.5(pi,pi,0), and re-run the same self-consistent gap equation over the realistic multi-sheet FS.

open_questions.question: Why is the model 2*Delta0/k_B*Th ratio (~8) far above the BCS value 3.53, and is the real SODW strong-coupling?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The gap-to-Tc ratio diagnoses coupling strength and the shape of Delta(T). A ratio of ~8 signals the self-consistency in this flat-nested band is strongly non-BCS, which affects the predicted specific-heat jump at Th.
open_questions.next_step: Compute Delta(T) with finer T resolution near Th and fit the mean-field order-parameter exponent; compare the specific-heat jump Delta C/C to the measured 24% entropy discontinuity.

open_questions.question: Can the naive Zeeman estimate B_c = 2*Delta0/(g*muB) (~106 T here) be reconciled with the experimental ~35 T once the field dependence of Delta and the anisotropic g-factor are included?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The predicted quantum critical field near 35 T is a headline falsifiable prediction of the SODW theory; our static gap-closing estimate overshoots by ~3x.
open_questions.next_step: Add a Zeeman term to H_k, recompute the self-consistent Delta(B) until it vanishes, and use the momentum-dependent g-factor from quantum-oscillation data rather than g=2.

open_questions.question: How does the competition/coexistence with the LMAF (SDW) order parameter (Das Eqs. 11-12, GL functional) shift the SODW gap and Th?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The HO->LMAF first-order transition under pressure/field is a defining feature of URu2Si2; the pure-SODW mean field here ignores the gamma|Delta_sodw|^2|Delta_sdw|^2 cross-coupling.
open_questions.next_step: Implement the two-field Ginzburg-Landau free energy F[Delta_sodw, Delta_sdw] with the alpha, beta, gamma coefficients of Eq. 12 and map the phase boundary in the (U/V, lambda/W) plane of Fig. 4.

open_questions.question: Is the SODW gap really time-reversal invariant (zero net moment) in the model, as Das proves analytically (Eq. 9)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The absence of an ordered magnetic moment is what makes the order 'hidden'; verifying it numerically in the model validates that our construction is a genuine SODW and not a disguised SDW.
open_questions.next_step: Evaluate the spin expectation S = (1/N) sum_k <c^dag_{k+Q} sigma c_k> in the self-consistent SODW ground state and confirm it vanishes for all V, as Eq. 9 predicts.

next_steps: Swap the toy tight-binding band for downfolded WIEN2k DFT bands at Q=0.5(pi,pi,0) and re-measure FS spectral-weight loss and entropy.
Add a Zeeman field term and self-consistently trace Delta(B) to extract a physical B_c for comparison with ~35 T.
Implement the two-order-parameter Ginzburg-Landau functional (Eq. 12) to capture SODW/SDW competition and the HO->LMAF transition.
Refine Delta(T) near Th and compute the specific-heat jump to test the 24% R ln2 entropy discontinuity.
Numerically confirm the vanishing ordered moment (Eq. 9) to certify the order as genuinely spin-orbit (hidden).
